title: 去除重复字母
summary: 删除重复字母使每个字母只出现一次，并在所有可行结果中获得字典序最小的字符串。
insight: 字符仍会在后面出现时，栈顶若比当前字符大就可安全弹出；每个字符只保留一次。
pitfalls: 只能弹出后续仍有剩余次数的字符
已经在栈中的字符直接跳过
弹出时要同步清除在栈标记

solutions.title: 单调栈贪心
solutions.idea: 剩余计数保证删除可恢复，栈保持尽可能小的字典序。
steps: 统计每个字符剩余次数
扫描时减少剩余次数，已入栈则跳过
弹出更大且仍会出现的栈顶，再压入当前字符

code.java: class Solution { public String removeDuplicateLetters(String s){int[] remaining=new int[26];boolean[] used=new boolean[26];for(char c:s.toCharArray())remaining[c-'a']++;StringBuilder stack=new StringBuilder();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){int index=c-'a';remaining[index]--;if(used[index])continue;while(stack.length()>0&&stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)>c&&remaining[stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)-'a']>0){used[stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)-'a']=false;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.length()-1);}stack.append(c);used[index]=true;}return stack.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun removeDuplicateLetters(s:String):String{val remaining=IntArray(26);val used=BooleanArray(26);for(c in s)remaining[c-'a']++;val stack=StringBuilder();for(c in s){val index=c-'a';remaining[index]--;if(used[index])continue;while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.last()>c&&remaining[stack.last()-'a']>0){used[stack.last()-'a']=false;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.lastIndex)};stack.append(c);used[index]=true};return stack.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string removeDuplicateLetters(string s){array<int,26> remaining{};array<bool,26> used{};for(char c:s)++remaining[c-'a'];string stack;for(char c:s){int index=c-'a';--remaining[index];if(used[index])continue;while(!stack.empty()&&stack.back()>c&&remaining[stack.back()-'a']>0){used[stack.back()-'a']=false;stack.pop_back();}stack.push_back(c);used[index]=true;}return stack;} };
